data.name: The Seal of R'lyeh
data.summary: A Lovecraftian expansion: the Occultist class (levels 1–20, four cults), two races – Innsmouth-Marked and Ghouls – a Wizard subclass, a skill tree for everyone, Eldritch Exposure & madness, and Withers' forbidden wares.

modfile.changelog:
Version 2.0 – "The Thousand Faces"

NEW CULT: CHURCH OF THE THOUSAND FACES (Nyarlathotep)
- Level 3: Dissonant Whispers, Charm Person, Mask of Many Faces (Disguise Self at will) and Seed of Discord.
- Level 6: The Black Man – when hit, show your true face as a reaction: the attacker is frightened and gains Eldritch Exposure.
- Level 10: The Black Pharaoh – once per long rest, deeply exposed enemies fight at your side.

NEW RACE: GHOULS
- Two subraces: Changeling and Dreamlands Ghoul. Grave Chill, Corpse Lore, Hunger and the Ghoul's Bite.
- Full appearance options in character creation, with a pale "Decay" skin by default.

NEW WIZARD SUBCLASS: SCHOOL OF FORBIDDEN LORE
- Copy Occultist spells into your spellbook (levels 2, 6 and 10).
- Marginalia, The Price of Knowledge, Mind at the Edge and The Necronomicon Opens.
- Added via Larian's progression merging – the Wizard's own data is not overwritten, so it works alongside other Wizard subclass mods.

LEVELS 13–20 (requires a level cap mod)
- The Occultist now has spell slots, spells and Forbidden Knowledge up to level 20.
- Five Mythic Rites: The Blasted Heath (13), Call the Star-Spawn (15), Dagon's Flood (17), The Gate and the Key (19), He Dreams No More (20).
- Level 17: No Mind Left to Lose. Level 20 capstone: The Seal Breaks.
- New cult features at level 14 for all four cults, and a second use of the level 10 power at level 18.

NEW 6TH-LEVEL SPELLS
- Call of a Shoggoth, The Hounds of Tindalos, The Shining Trapezohedron – plus Circle of Death, Eyebite and Harm.

LIBRARY OF MADNESS
- Fourth branch: Branch of the Thousand Faces – False Face, Whispered Discord, The Crawling Chaos, Face of the Messenger.

WITHERS' WARES (Act 2 & 3)
- Mask of the Yellow King (level 6), Mi-Go Carapace (level 8), Ring of the Trapezohedron (level 10).
- New consumables: Brine Vial (lowers Eldritch Exposure) and Dreamweed (advantage on Wisdom saves).

NEW BACKGROUND: SCHOLAR OF MISKATONIC
- Arcana and Investigation, plus seminar notes in your pack.

OTHER
- The Occultist now counts as both Wizard and Sorcerer for dialogue options.
- All new spells, items, races and classes have custom hand-drawn icons.

Existing saves work. Start a new character to play the Ghouls, the new background or the Wizard subclass.

data.name: Sura
data.summary: Powerful level 1-20 Sura class with sword combos, Ninja arts, stances, Willpower and Black Spirit Rage. Designed for solo play on the hardest difficulty. Includes Mistbound clothing. Levels 13-20 need a level-cap mod. No Script Extender needed

modfile.changelog:
**jodan & Legendary Equipment update**

- **jodan bonus** now performs a full main-hand weapon attack instead of a 1d4 strike. Costs one Bonus Action and no Willpower. Includes normal weapon modifiers, enchantment and on-hit effects. Still requires a qualifying hit in Jodan and is available once per turn.
- **mistbound Raiment, Kasa, Bracers, Footwraps and mantle** are now Legendary. Equipment growth follows total character level.
- **raiment** now provides base AC of 12 + Dexterity modifier + Wisdom modifier, alongside its existing level-based AC bonuses. Gains Slashing, Piercing and Bludgeoning resistance at level 11. Retains those resistances alongside flat 2 physical damage reduction at level 17.
- **kasa** now grants Alert at level 5, replacing its previous initiative bonus. Adds Perception proficiency and Expertise at level 11.
- **bracers** now grant +1/+2/+3 to attack rolls at levels 5/11/17. Fast Hands grants an additional Bonus Action from level 5.
- **footwraps** now grant +3/+5/+8 m movement at levels 5/11/17.
- **sura katana** now grants an additional Reaction while wielded in the main hand from level 5. Qualifying weapon hits and physical Sura cuts can also inflict Poisoned for two turns on a failed DC 13 Constitution save. Additional Sura Strike tails do not trigger this effect.

**new Legendary accessories**

- **mistbound Phantom band** grants +1/+2/+3/+4 Sleight of Hand at levels 1/5/11/17, plus Advantage on Stealth checks from level 11.
- **mistbound Trail band** grants +1/+2/+3/+4 Perception at levels 1/5/11/17 and ignores Difficult Terrain’s movement penalty from level 11.
- **mistbound Spirit seal** grants +2/+4/+6/+8 maximum HP at levels 1/5/11/17, Psychic resistance from level 5 and Frightened immunity from level 17.

New accessories are included in newly created Sura characters’ starting equipment. They are not automatically added to existing characters.

**fixes**

- Corrected equipment resistance application for the Raiment, Spirit Seal and Mantle.
- Prevented equipment-granted Alert and Fast Hands from duplicating their existing native features.
- Updated affected descriptions.

data.name: [Swordmage]BG3 Class MOD
data.summary: 剑法师将奥术融入近战，让法术成为武艺的一部分。他们的攻击不止来自剑刃，更来自烈焰、闪电与奔涌的奥能。

modfile.changelog:
本次更新内容如下： 1、新增了13~20级内容。不过因为正在对子职业进行重做，所以只有本职业的能力而没有子职业的能力。如果你要升级到13级及更高等级，你需要一个能够解锁等级上限的mod，理论上任意一个即可。测试期间使用的mod是：Expansion。 1.1、新增高等级能力： 14 奥能屏障 当你将要受到伤害时，你可以使用一个反应并消耗1点奥能，使此次伤害减少等于你的剑法师等级＋智力调整值的数值。你必须持用剑誓武器且副手空置，才能使用此特性。 15 子职业特性 暂无 18 子职业特性 暂无 术法极意 选择1个6环法术，你始终准备这个法术，你可以不消耗法术位释放这个法术，但每次长休之前只能使用1次 19 专长/属性提升 正常ASI/Feat 20 魔武合一 "你对魔法与剑技的掌握已臻化境。你获得以下增益。 【属性值强化】选择力量或敏捷。你的智力和所选属性提升 2 ，至多提升至 23 。 【魔武合一】当你投掷先攻时，若你的奥能不足 2 ，则你的奥能恢复至 2 。" 2、对原有部分能力的修正： 2.1、剑誓 你可以使用一个动作，与一把不具有双手属性的近战武器结成剑誓。你同时只能拥有一把剑誓武器。当你与另一把武器结成剑誓时，先前那把武器的剑誓立即结束。剑誓持续至你完成一次长休，或你死亡。当你使用剑誓武器进行攻击时，你可以使用智力调整值代替力量或敏捷调整值，计算该攻击的攻击检定与伤害掷骰。 删除了“在克服对非魔法攻击和伤害的抗性与免疫时，你使用剑誓武器进行的攻击视为魔法攻击。” 2.2、6级特性双锋修改为【剑与诗篇】 剑与诗篇 你将剑击与施法衔接为连贯的攻势。当你持用剑誓武器且副手空置时，在你的回合内获得如下效果。
【诗篇】每回合一次，在进行至少一次武器攻击后，你可以使用一个附赠动作，施展一个施法时间为 1 动作的 [1] 环及以下的法术或戏法。
【剑语】每回合一次，当你以 1 动作施展法术或戏法后，你可以使用一个附赠动作，进行一次武器攻击。 2.3、11级狂澜移动到10级。 2.4、11级新增特性【涌动精通】 涌动精通 你自如调整奥能的流向，将其塑造为不同的涌动之力。每回合一次，奥能涌动持续期间且未受阻时，你可以选择并获得下列一种效果。效果持续至你选择另一种效果，或涌动结束。 【御空】你以奥能托起身体，保持离地。你获得飞行能力，并且不受地表效果影响。 【调谐】你调整奥能以适应不同的能量。你获得所选元素的伤害抗性，且你的攻击额外附加 1d6 该元素类型的伤害。 【定势】你用奥能护持周身。你不会被推拉和击倒，且你维持专注的豁免检定具有优势。

data.summary: Early-access Bounty Hunter class with firearms, three routes and progression through level 20. Requires UnlockLevelCurve. Custom models, animations, companion art, balance and multiplayer testing are in progress.

modfile.changelog:
Bounty Hunter 1.0.1.16 - Grapple, companions and forge fixes

- Includes the grapple update: paired hold/release/break presentation for supported Human, Elf and Drow bodies, higher-Strength-or-Dexterity escape checks, and attack Advantage against grappled targets.
- Updates firearm ranged-attack and extra-action compatibility, preserving restored gun holds and firing.
- Restores Deputy Revolver and Hide access, and adds jump phases for the Deputy and four elemental lizards.
- Fixes early reward inventory transfers by waiting for spawned rewards to become ready.
- Original Grymforge Rifle Mould crafting and rifle pickup passed a Toolkit test.

VALIDATION AND EARLY ACCESS
Clean native Story build: 0 errors, 0 warnings. Package contents verified; private test helpers removed. Grapple gameplay is not yet verified.

Reload appearance, attachment/audio and companion transitions still need polish. Grapple body coverage is limited; other races and arbitrary custom bodies are unfinished. Mould ejection, repeat crafting, the Grym encounter, all campaign placements, existing saves and multiplayer are not fully verified. Flesh to Gold still needs split/previously owned gold-stack checks.

Requires UnlockLevelCurve - Level 13-20 | Patch 8. No Script Extender required. Fully restart BG3 after updating; co-op players must use matching versions and dependencies.
